title: Time tracking
subtitle: Working hours, breaks, vacation and absences

clock.toastIn: Clocked in – have a good one!

overview.clockUnavailable: The clock isn't available right now
overview.autoClosedNotice: {count, plural, one {One entry was} other {# entries were}} closed automatically at 18:00.
overview.warningsNotice: This week {count, plural, one {one day has} other {# days have}} a Working Hours Act notice.
overview.pendingNotice: {count, plural, one {One request is} other {# requests are}} waiting for approval.

entries.autoClosedHint: Still clocked in at 18:00 – the end was set from your regular hours. Please check and correct it if needed.
entries.pendingChip: {count, plural, one {1 correction pending} other {# corrections pending}}
entries.lockedHint: This month is closed. Changes only after an admin unlocks it.
entries.requested: Correction requested – an admin will review it.
entries.requestHint: Changes to booked time are saved as a correction and apply once an admin approves them.
entries.endBeforeStart: The end has to be after the start.
entries.deleteHintDirect: The entry stops counting but stays in the audit log.
entries.deleteHint: The removal is requested as a correction and applies once approved.

break30.label: Break < 30 min
break30.hint: More than 6 hours of work need at least 30 minutes of break (§ 4 ArbZG). Breaks count from 15 minutes.

break45.label: Break < 45 min
break45.hint: More than 9 hours of work need at least 45 minutes of break (§ 4 ArbZG).

over10h.label: Over 10 h
over10h.hint: More than 10 hours of work a day aren't allowed under § 3 ArbZG.

rest11h.label: Rest < 11 h
rest11h.hint: There should be at least 11 hours of rest between two working days (§ 5 ArbZG).

absences.emptyHint: Request vacation or report sick using the buttons above.
absences.daysLabel: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
absences.requested: Request sent – admins have been notified.
absences.sickHint: Sick days apply immediately; admins are informed.
absences.directHint: Entered as an admin – approved right away.
absences.approvalHint: Takes effect once an admin approves it. Holidays and days off don't count as vacation.

calendar.hint: Team vacation. Other people's sick days and other absences aren't shown.
calendar.empty: Nobody is on vacation this month.

admin.holidaysSeeded: {count, plural, =0 {All holidays were already there} one {1 holiday added} other {# holidays added}}
admin.noHolidaysHint: Add Bavaria's (Nürnberg) holidays plus the company rules with one click.
admin.locksHint: A month closes automatically on the 15th of the following month at 00:00. After that, changes need an unlock with a reason.
admin.unlockHint: The reason goes into the audit log. Lock the month again once you're done.
admin.auditEmpty: Nothing in the audit log yet
admin.scheduleHint: Target hours per weekday from a date on, so earlier months stay correct.
admin.defaultSchedule: Default: 8 hours Monday to Friday (40 h/week).
admin.allowanceHint: Without an entry it's 24 days. Carried-over days lapse on 31 March.
admin.openingHint: Hours account at the start, e.g. taken over from Clockodo. Counting starts on the date.
admin.noOpening: No opening balance – the account starts at 0.

errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.month_locked: This month is closed. Changes only after an admin unlocks it.
errors.running_entry: The running entry can only be changed after clocking out.
errors.in_future: Time in the future can't be booked.
errors.invalid_range: Please check the date and time.
errors.already_pending: A correction for this entry is already waiting.
errors.not_pending: That was decided in the meantime.
errors.changed_meanwhile: The entry changed in the meantime. Please reload.
errors.no_working_days: There are no working days in that period.
